name: Algebra II
subject: math
syllabus: Algebra II builds on the rigour of Algebra I with quadratics, exponential functions, polynomial division, sequences and series, and an intro to logarithms. Problem-solving fluency is graded weekly.

name: AP Biology
subject: science
syllabus: AP Biology covers cellular processes, genetics, evolution, and ecology with a strong laboratory emphasis. Lab work is exemplary; aim for tighter conclusions.

name: English Lit
subject: english
syllabus: Close-reading and analytical writing across American and British literary traditions. Push topic sentences in essays.

name: World History
subject: history
syllabus: Survey of world civilizations from antiquity to the modern era. Solid analysis. Cite primary sources more often.

name: Studio Art
subject: art
syllabus: Foundational drawing, painting, and mixed-media studio practice with end-of-term portfolio. Outstanding portfolio cohesion.

name: Spanish III
subject: language
syllabus: Conversational fluency, irregular verb mastery, and short-form composition. Conversational fluency improving; review irregular verbs.

name: PE / Health
subject: pe
syllabus: Cardio, strength, team sports, and adolescent health curriculum. Excellent participation and team leadership.
